findings.finding: Found by the measurement, not the reviewer: endpoint names keep trailing punctuation ("calls POST /api/timesheets." gives "/api/timesheets."), so a producer and its consumers do not match. In h2-portal the planner put Q-4 (producer) in one wave with Q-5 and Q-6 (consumers). Every arm-B agent caught it and moved them, partly from the Jev shadow suggestion. A path like portal/api/TimesheetController.cs. is also read as an endpoint.
findings.resolution: open: tool bug, present before this rework; not fixed in the measured commit aff05cf. Needs a fix + test before adoption.

findings.finding: Any WORD-digits token after a ref verb (needs CVE-2024, after UTF-8) was treated as an out-of-batch story, holding the story and its dependents back.
findings.resolution: fixed in aff05cf: a text ref is external only when its prefix is one the batch ids use; explicit links stay external; test added

findings.finding: Text refs were not upper-cased, so 'depends on s-2' with S-2 in the batch became an external dependency and no edge.
findings.resolution: fixed in aff05cf: refs are upper-cased; test added

findings.finding: Bare numeric refs to ids outside the batch ('after 1234') are silently ignored while 'after AB-1' blocks.
findings.resolution: open: by design (bare numbers are too noisy); not documented in SKILL.md yet
no change needed: the filter /depend|predecessor|blocked/ does not match 'blocks' (the reviewer had not run it)
